## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and change. Identify application or driver ownership.

## Verification

Exact source/platform, commands, results, skips and limits. No instrument required.
State generated-asset changes or the required maintainer regeneration.

## Source rights and privacy

Retain licenses and attribution. Exclude private records, personal paths,
credentials and raw instrument/bench data. Do not claim physical qualification
or upstream acceptance from software checks.
